items.title_en: Is That An iPhone? 1937 Painting Leaves Internet Puzzled Over Man’s Mysterious Object
items.title_zh: 那是 iPhone 吗？ 1937 年的绘画让互联网对人类的神秘物体感到困惑
items.summary_en: A 1937 painting has sparked a strange online debate after viewers spotted a man holding a small rectangular object that looks surprisingly like a modern smartphone.
items.summary_zh: 一幅 1937 年的画作在网上引发了一场奇怪的争论，因为观众发现一名男子拿着一个长方形的小物体，看起来惊人地像一部现代智能手机。
